notes.title: Introduction of the Gauntlet mode
notes.notes:
Hello! It has been a while (well a bit more than a while) since Holt got a update. Holt's development has been slow but I wanted to provide some content to allow for players to still enjoy the game. Introducing the Gauntlet mode! This is a wave based survival mode that players will have to build defenses to protect a unknown relic from the enemies. Use a variety of unique weapons that will spawn on the ground to shoot, slash, and punch your way to victory.

This mode is still in early development so some features are missing and are subject to change. I hope when I have time again to add more to the mode to allow for more endless play time.

This is just a small update and I hope to be back soon to show off more content!

-Frog

notes.title: The state of Holt
notes.notes:
Hello all,

So at this moment, Holt and its development has been slow and almost at a stand still. Over the past couple of months, I have been slowed down with other life issues as well as an urge to work on smaller projects as well. As of this moment, Holt will be delayed for some time and I am not sure when I will be able to pick it back up. I hope for when I finish with my college education I can continue once again. In the meantime, I will be working more on the story and building the universe more. I am sorry for the sad news and I hope Holt will come back better than ever.

Take it easy

-Frog

notes.title: Holt Patch (Too Many Games 2021)
notes.notes:
Hello all! So some changes have gone through for the game they are small for now but I hope you enjoy some of the tweaks! If any issues come up please feel free to message our discord or leave a post on our community hub! 

[h1][u][b]New:[/b][/u][/h1]

-Mouse and keyboard support

Dev Note:
The voices of the reviews have been heard and we finally got around to adding mouse and keyboard support to the game. The controller is still an option to so need to worry!

-Flutter Frogs

Dev Note:
Flutter Frogs appeared soon after the invasion. These frogs look like any normal one. However, the Teredit swamps were being tainted with Axelite crystals that caused them to sprout crystal wings. Whacking these frogs will tend to drop players shards of Axelite to use in shops

-Sliding!

Dev Note:
We thought it would be fun to add more movement to the game so we allow for Holt to now slide!

-Multiple weapon types and orbital gun movement and reload animations

Dev Note:
The LMG in the first early access limited players' creativity and allowing for custom builds for Holt. We have now introduced 3 new weapon types for the player to play around with. Gun movement in all directions is now possible to help players take aim at different angles. Also, say goodbye to the cool-down meter for the LMG. Guns will have cool custom reloads for each unique weapon type.

[h1][u][b]Tweaks:[/b][/u][/h1]

-Changes to the income system
-Players can now anchor themselves on to walls to have more control on environment climbing
-UI meter for Evu
-Better identification of allies’ vs enemies, environmental’s, and interactable’s
-Changes to the intro cutscene and all cutscenes throughout the beta of the first chapter

[h1][u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u][/h1]

-Tweaked on wall interactions to have a more seamless feel
-Optimization to music to help on lower-end computers

[h1][u][b]Changes to come:[/b][/u][/h1]

-Language options

Dev Note:
After reading many reviews I have seen that the need for Chinese is on the rise. I hope to have a language feature working but there is no ETA on when that will be added. Once again I am sorry it is not in right at launch but I am only one man and it does take some time. Please know I want everyone to be able to enjoy the story of Holt and I will work the best I can to get it into the game!

-Post-processing settings and key bindings

Dev Note:
Many players have also made it clear that in some areas it tends to be too dark and they would like to change it to better suit them. Also, custom key binds have also been requested as well. I am also working on this feature as well however this doesn’t have an exact date for what patch this might come. This is in the work and I will update with it as it develops.

Enjoy!

-Frog

notes.title: Too Many Games 2021 and upcoming patch
notes.notes:
Hello all got another update! This one will be short and sweet.

TLDR: Holt will be at Too Many Games and a Holt patch is coming soon

[h1][b]Too Many Games 2021:[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827091/0cdcf1001683004907fc08c4952c8df09a574cd7.png[/img]

Holt will be at Too Many Games this year which is from Oct 8-10 at the Greater Philadelphia Expo Center! If you are local to the area come check it out!

[h1][b]Holt Patch and fixes:[/b][/h1]

Lots of feedback has come back and your voices have been heard. Some tweaks will be coming to Holt with keyboard support and some minor tweaks to enemies and performance. A detailed patch note will be released at the time of the update which will be soon. This patch will either go live before the Too Many Games convention or after but we will see. I am sorry this update has taken so long and I know there is more that needs to be done and I am working hard to have it all fixed!

Until next time!

-Frog
